decisions.reason: As a close-to-core service line in an expanding firm with a still relatively narrow portfolio, offshore vessel management preserves strategic upside in offshore and renewable markets and is unlikely to be dropped unless demand has clearly disappointed.

Crew and corporate travel management fits tightly with the firm's existing crew, administration and support activities, so its carrying cost is likely low and its option value as an integrated client service remains high.

The online vessel information portal extends the established service offer and can strengthen customer retention, but as a digital add-on it faces somewhat higher risk of being discontinued or folded into other systems if usage has not scaled.

The mobile vessel performance app is adjacent to the core business and supports the firm's move toward higher-value, data-enabled services, yet among these launches it is the most exposed to being dropped if customer uptake or operational benefits have become clearer and weaker than hoped.
